note_zh: 18项按《北京市城市更新项目库管理办法（试行）》口径接入市、区两级项目库（条件门齐备申报入库、未达标动态出库），并设3年评估—6年换装—不达标回退的自适应周期。台账为概念级治理模板：权属状态均为待核验、KPI基线均待试点前实测冻结、责任仅列类型不指认机构（A为依法定程序最终确认的主管或业主责任主体）；实体项目走「条件门—验收—停工复核」，AI场景走「黄/红牌—人工接管—恢复—退役」。本文件为 visual 台账面板与 A3 台账页的同源机器可读数据；human_review/no_ai_alternative/appeal_channel 三项字段完备率由本文件的 field_completeness 直接统计（分子为该字段非空的场景数、分母为场景总数），它们是本文件的字段统计、不是 metrics.json 的登记指标，量的是设计承诺完备性、非运行实测。
language_note: 场景与项目台账字段目前仅有中文；画像核验表为中英双语。English readers: the persona table below is bilingual; the scenario and project ledgers are currently Chinese-only.

executable_pilot_cards.note_zh: 三张可执行卡回应公开意见通道第 002 号意见（issue #215）。可交付的是字段结构、冻结机制与责任归属；阈值数值必须来自试点前的实测基线，本包不编造数值——SC-12 是例外，它的成功口径是包内一致性，无需等待试点即可执行。第 003–004 号回应（2026-08-10）后补齐三字段：受益或担风险、资源与许可、申诉与问责路径；申诉字段同时回答第 003 号意见指出的三处缺口——样本口径的独立确认角色、删除记录的出具对象与回读位置、外部异议独立触发复核的入口。
executable_pilot_cards.note_en: These three cards answer comment 002 in the public channel (issue #215). What is deliverable now is the field structure, the freezing mechanism and accountability; threshold values must come from a measured pre-pilot baseline and are not invented here. SC-12 is the exception: its success criterion is internal consistency, enforceable immediately. After responses 003–004 (2026-08-10) three fields were added — who benefits and who bears risk, resources and permissions, and the appeal and accountability path; the appeal field also answers the three gaps named in comment 003: an independent confirmer for the sample definition, whom deletion records are issued to and where they can be read back, and an entry point for external objections to trigger a review on their own.

fields.en: Who benefits and who bears risk

cards.baseline_zh: 改造前连续四周的过街等候时长分布与断面步行流量（同点位、同时段口径）；待试点前实测冻结（当前无实测基线，不填数值）
cards.baseline_en: Four weeks of pre-intervention crossing wait times and footway flows at the same points and hours; frozen from a measured baseline before the pilot; no value stated yet
cards.window_zh: 首期 12 周；工作日早晚高峰各 2 小时 + 周末 1 个时段；样本为断面级聚合计数，无个体标识
cards.window_en: 12 weeks; two peak hours on weekdays plus one weekend window; sample is section-level aggregate counts with no individual identifiers
cards.success_zh: 过街等候时长中位数较基线改善且无安全事件；改善幅度阈值待试点前实测冻结（当前无实测基线，不填数值）
cards.success_en: Median crossing wait improves against baseline with zero safety incidents; the improvement threshold is frozen from a measured baseline before the pilot; no value stated yet
cards.stop_zh: 任一安全事件、或建议与现场信号状态不一致累计达设定次数、或投诉未在一个工作日内响应——即红牌暂停并回退常规过街设施
cards.stop_en: Any safety incident, or advice inconsistent with the actual signal state reaching the set count, or a complaint unanswered within one working day — red card, revert to conventional crossing infrastructure
cards.owner_zh: 运营方交通值守班组（角色，非机构指认）；红牌权同时归属属地社区代表
cards.owner_en: The operator's traffic watch team (a role, not a named body); community representatives hold an equal red-card right
cards.human_alt_zh: 常规过街设施与原信号配时全程保留可用，不因试点降低服务
cards.human_alt_en: Conventional crossings and the original signal timing stay fully available throughout; the pilot never degrades the baseline service
cards.deletion_zh: 聚合计数保留≤90天，到期自动删除；红牌或退役时立即清缓存并出具删除记录（时间、范围、执行人、核验人）
cards.deletion_en: Aggregate counts kept ≤90 days then auto-deleted; on red card or retirement the cache is cleared immediately and a deletion record is issued (time, scope, executor, verifier)
cards.review_zh: 每 4 周一次复盘并公开纪要；红牌后须完成责任复核与受影响群体反馈方可转黄观察一周期
cards.review_en: Review every four weeks with published minutes; after a red card, accountability review and affected-group feedback must complete before a yellow observation period
cards.benefit_zh: 受益：北三环两侧步行通勤者与过街人群（含无障碍需求者）——等候更短、指引更清晰；担风险：同一批过街者（指引失准）与值守班组（处置负担）。沿用公共利益三原则：服务等价、弱势群体不作首轮测试对象、受影响群体代表持红牌权
cards.benefit_en: Benefits: crossers on both sides of the North Third Ring, including people with accessibility needs. Risk bearers: the same crossers (misleading guidance) and the watch team (response burden). Equal service, no vulnerable groups in round one, affected-group red-card power
cards.resources_zh: 需要：既有信号配时数据的只读接入（配时权属不变）、断面计数设备的安装许可与供电、站点二维码张贴位；许可主体与审批路径待深化阶段确认，未取得许可不启动
cards.resources_en: Needs: read-only signal-timing data (timing authority unchanged), installation permission and power for the counters, a spot for the QR code; permitting bodies are confirmed at the detailing stage — no permission, no start
cards.appeal_zh: 样本口径由独立于值守班组的复核角色确认，确认人不得与执行人同源；删除记录向复核角色与社区代表出具，回读位置为意见—回应台账；申诉入口为站点二维码与公开意见通道——外部异议即使不构成投诉、未触发红牌，也可独立要求一次复核并获三态回应
cards.appeal_en: A review role independent of the watch team confirms the sample definition; deletion records go to that role and the community representatives, readable in the opinion–response ledger; appeals enter via QR code or the public channel — an objection that triggers no card can still demand one review and gets a three-state answer

cards.name_zh: 智能园艺与生态监测（测试）
cards.baseline_zh: 首季人工对照组：常规定时养护下的植被长势判读准确率与用水量；待试点前实测冻结（当前无实测基线，不填数值）
cards.baseline_en: A first-season human control group: recognition accuracy and water use under conventional scheduled maintenance; frozen from a measured baseline before the pilot; no value stated yet
cards.window_zh: 一个完整生长季；样本为固定摄位植被影像与环境传感，不含人像；设同条件对照区段
cards.window_en: One full growing season; sample is fixed-position vegetation imagery and environmental sensing with no people in frame; a matched control section runs alongside
cards.success_zh: 识别准确率与节水率同时优于人工对照组；两项阈值待试点前实测冻结（当前无实测基线，不填数值）
cards.success_en: Both recognition accuracy and water saving beat the human control group; both thresholds are frozen from a measured baseline before the pilot; no value stated yet
cards.stop_zh: 任何危及植被或公众安全的误动作即红牌；连续两个考核周期未达标转黄牌
cards.stop_en: Any erroneous action endangering vegetation or the public triggers a red card; two consecutive periods below target trigger a yellow card
cards.owner_zh: 绿化养护运营方 + 技术供应方双列名（角色）；养护班组持现场停止权
cards.owner_en: Landscape maintenance operator and technology supplier jointly named (roles); the maintenance crew holds on-site stop authority
cards.human_alt_zh: 常规定时养护全程可回退，回退不需要技术方同意
cards.human_alt_en: Conventional scheduled maintenance can be reinstated at any time, and reinstatement does not require the supplier's consent
cards.deletion_zh: 原始影像保留≤180天；退役时按既定规则删除并出具删除记录，评测结果与失败档案公开留存
cards.deletion_en: Raw imagery kept ≤180 days; on retirement it is deleted under the agreed rule with a deletion record issued, while evaluation results and the failure log remain public
cards.review_zh: 每月巡检 + 每季度对照评测；失败记录逐条公开，供后续场景引用避坑
cards.review_en: Monthly inspection plus quarterly controlled evaluation; every failure is logged publicly so later scenarios can avoid the same trap
cards.benefit_zh: 受益：绿廊植被与日常使用者（养护更准、用水更省）；担风险：植被本身（误灌溉、误修剪）与养护班组（对照与处置负担）。试验对象是植被不是公众，影像不含人像
cards.benefit_en: Benefits: the corridor's vegetation and its daily users (better maintenance, less water). Risk bearers: the vegetation itself (mis-irrigation, mis-pruning) and the maintenance crew (workload). The trial tests vegetation, not the public; imagery contains no people
cards.resources_zh: 需要：绿地养护作业许可、固定摄位安装许可、灌溉系统接口的受控访问；用水用电走既有养护口径，许可与预算主体待深化阶段确认
cards.resources_en: Needs: the maintenance work permit, consent for fixed camera positions, controlled access to the irrigation interface; water and power run under the existing maintenance arrangement, bodies confirmed at the detailing stage
cards.appeal_zh: 人工对照组的选段与指标由独立于技术供应方的养护复核角色确认；删除记录向该复核角色出具、入台账可回读；现场公示牌载明反馈入口——居民与养护人员的异议即使未触发红黄牌，也可独立要求一次复核并获三态回应
cards.appeal_en: A maintenance review role independent of the supplier confirms the control group's sections and indicators; deletion records go to that role, readable in the ledger; the notice board carries the feedback entry — an objection that triggers no card can still demand one review with a three-state answer

cards.baseline_zh: 本包当前指标即基线：50 项已复算指标与 4 项待正式数据补齐的控制指标，口径见 metrics.json
cards.baseline_en: This package's current metrics are the baseline: 50 recomputed metrics and 4 control values pending official data, as declared in metrics.json
cards.window_zh: 随版本 K 标滚动；每次官方数据到位触发一次整包重算与展示更新
cards.window_en: Rolls with each version K-marker; every arrival of official data triggers one whole-package recomputation and display update
cards.success_zh: 展示数值与 metrics.json 逐位一致率 100%，且待补齐指标在展示层不出现数值——这是可立即执行的硬性口径，不需等试点
cards.success_en: Displayed values match metrics.json digit for digit at 100%, and pending metrics never appear as numbers in the display layer — an immediately enforceable rule that needs no pilot
cards.stop_zh: 任一图层口径不一致即下架该图层并公示原因；构建期断言失败则该版本不予发布
cards.stop_en: Any layer whose values disagree is withdrawn with a published reason; if the build-time assertion fails, that version is not released
cards.owner_zh: 展示运营方 + 数据口径委员会（角色）；开源仓库 issue 为公开申诉入口
cards.owner_en: Exhibition operator and a data-definition committee (roles); the public appeal route is an issue in the open-source repository
cards.human_alt_zh: 静态图纸与印刷指标手册全程并存，断电断网不影响查阅
cards.human_alt_en: Static drawings and a printed metrics handbook are always available; loss of power or network does not affect access
cards.deletion_zh: 仅使用公开数据集，不接入个人数据，因而无个人数据删除义务；展项撤展时归档留存
cards.deletion_en: Only public datasets are used and no personal data is ingested, so no personal-data deletion obligation arises; on withdrawal the exhibit is archived
cards.review_zh: 每次版本 K 标更新后人工核对一次并留存一致性核查记录
cards.review_en: A human consistency check after every version K-marker update, with the check record retained
cards.benefit_zh: 受益：查阅城市模型的公众与后续智能体（可复算的公共数据资产）；担风险：主要是认知风险——展示与包内口径不一致会误导读者，这正是把一致性定为成功口径的原因。不接入个人数据，无个体数据风险承担方
cards.benefit_en: Benefits: the public consulting the model and later agents (a recomputable public data asset). The risk is cognitive — an inconsistent display would mislead readers, which is why consistency is the success criterion. No personal data, so no individual bears data risk
cards.resources_zh: 需要：展示枢纽的展位与供电（依托一期「智算展示枢纽」项目落位）、开源仓库托管（已具备）；仅用公开数据集，无个人数据许可需求
cards.resources_en: Needs: exhibition space and power at the hub (sited with the phase-one exhibition-hub project), open-source hosting (in place); only public datasets, no personal-data permission needed
cards.appeal_zh: 口径一致性由构建期断言与人工核对双重确认——断言在管道里、核对留记录；开源仓库 issue 为公开申诉入口，任何人可就不一致发起异议并获三态回应，处理过程与下架原因公开入台账
cards.appeal_en: Consistency is confirmed twice — build-time assertion in the pipeline, recorded human check; the repository issue channel is the public appeal route: anyone can challenge an inconsistency, gets a three-state answer, and reads the handling and any withdrawal reason in the ledger

personas.note_zh: 六类画像×过道岔条件；可审查指标须试点后真实记录，当前无数值。
personas.note_en: Six personas × switch-admission conditions. Reviewable indicators are recorded after a pilot; no values are claimed now.

rows.exclusion_zh: 算力与数据门槛、评测口径黑箱
rows.exclusion_en: Compute and data thresholds; opaque evaluation criteria
rows.floor_zh: 公开评测口径与申诉复评通道
rows.floor_en: Published evaluation criteria and an appeal route
rows.indicator_zh: 复评申请响应时长（试点后记录）
rows.indicator_en: Response time to re-evaluation requests (recorded after pilot)

rows.exclusion_zh: 场景清单信息不对称、准入流程繁复
rows.exclusion_en: Asymmetric information on the scenario list; heavy admission process
rows.floor_zh: 清单公开+道岔评审标准公开
rows.floor_en: Public scenario list and published switch-review criteria
rows.indicator_zh: 申请到答复时长（试点后记录）
rows.alt_zh: 线下服务窗口与人工对接
rows.alt_en: Offline service counter and human liaison

rows.exclusion_zh: 场景试验田排期不透明、数据接口不开放
rows.exclusion_en: Opaque testbed scheduling; closed data interfaces
rows.floor_zh: 场景开放清单与道岔排期公示
rows.floor_en: Published scenario list and switch scheduling
rows.indicator_zh: 申请到进场时长（试点后记录）
rows.alt_zh: 线下对接窗口与人工排期
rows.alt_en: Offline liaison desk and manual scheduling

rows.exclusion_zh: 设备与会员门槛、课业时段冲突
rows.exclusion_en: Device and membership thresholds; timetable clashes
rows.floor_zh: 免费公共时段+无账号即可体验
rows.floor_en: Free public hours; no account required to take part
rows.indicator_zh: 免费时段占比（试点后记录）
rows.indicator_en: Share of free opening hours (recorded after pilot)
rows.alt_en: In-person courses and the physical market

rows.exclusion_zh: 必须扫码、语音过快、界面频繁变化
rows.exclusion_en: Mandatory QR entry; speech too fast; interfaces that change often
rows.floor_zh: 纸质/人工同等入口，大字高对比，座椅遮荫连续
rows.floor_en: Equal paper and staffed entry; large high-contrast type; continuous seating and shade
rows.indicator_zh: 非数字入口可用率（试点后记录）
rows.indicator_en: Availability of non-digital entry points (recorded after pilot)
rows.alt_zh: 人工服务台与电话渠道
rows.alt_en: Staffed service desk and telephone channel

rows.zh: 国际访问者与客座专家
rows.exclusion_zh: 单语界面、支付与认证壁垒
rows.exclusion_en: Monolingual interfaces; payment and identity barriers
rows.floor_zh: 双语导视+免注册基础服务
rows.floor_en: Bilingual wayfinding; basic services without registration
rows.indicator_zh: 双语覆盖率（试点后记录）

cross_cutting_review_group.zh: 残障使用者（贯穿各画像的核验群体）
cross_cutting_review_group.en: Disabled users (a review group cutting across every persona)
cross_cutting_review_group.exclusion_zh: 坡道断点、错误导航、设备占据通行带
cross_cutting_review_group.exclusion_en: Ramp breaks; wrong navigation; equipment occupying the accessible route
cross_cutting_review_group.floor_zh: 无障碍代表参与验收；错误即回退静态导视
cross_cutting_review_group.floor_en: Accessibility representatives join acceptance; on error, fall back to static wayfinding
cross_cutting_review_group.indicator_zh: 连续通行率、问题关闭率（试点后记录）
cross_cutting_review_group.indicator_en: Continuity of accessible routes and issue-closure rate (recorded after pilot)
cross_cutting_review_group.alt_zh: 人工伴行与纸质无障碍图
cross_cutting_review_group.alt_en: Staffed accompaniment and a printed accessibility map

scenarios.name: 轴上通勤助手
scenarios.legal: 个保法最小必要（聚合匿名口径）；接入信号配时须交管规定
scenarios.alt: 常规过街设施与原信号配时全程保留可用

agent_io.read: 聚合匿名人流计数、信号灯当前状态（只读）
agent_io.decide: 过街建议展示内容与配时优化建议（建议权）
agent_io.escalate: 任何配时变更的实际执行、公众投诉处置
agent_io.halt: 红牌即停止显示，回退常规过街设施

dp.fields: 断面级人流计数（无个体标识）
dp.sharing: 不出运营方；聚合统计可公开
dp.deletion: 到期自动删除，红牌/退役即清缓存

scenarios.resp_pre: 运营方交通值守（R）；交管部门批准配时试验前不得接入信号
scenarios.data_privacy: 聚合匿名人流计数；不采个体轨迹；数据保留≤90天
scenarios.kpi: 过街等候时长、建议采纳率；基线待试点前实测冻结，阈值随基线公示
scenarios.review_accept: 值守班组日检；验收=聚合统计报告+公众反馈摘要
scenarios.stop_chain: 暂停=建议失准或投诉；申诉=站点二维码+社区代表红牌权；恢复=整改复核+黄牌观察一周期；退役=停止采集并删除缓存

scenarios.name: 无障碍与适老出行
scenarios.legal: 个保法敏感信息从严：本地处理、不外传；无障碍设施规范验收
scenarios.alt: 社区服务站人工响应与人工伴行

agent_io.read: 用户主动发起的求助与路径请求、无障碍设施状态
agent_io.escalate: 紧急求助转人工、设施报修确认
agent_io.halt: 响应失效即停用智能入口，保留人工热线

dp.fields: 求助内容与位置（本地处理）
dp.deletion: 到期删除；用户可即时要求删除

scenarios.resp_pre: 社区服务站（R）+助残组织顾问（C）；场地为现状人行空间，改造须无障碍设计审查
scenarios.data_privacy: 求助呼叫与路径请求，本地处理；不设强制识别；记录保留≤30天
scenarios.kpi: 求助响应时长、无障碍路径可达率；基线由残障用户实测确定（首轮非弱势测试原则不适用于受益型服务，但须监护陪同）
scenarios.review_accept: 人工响应全程兜底；验收=残障用户测试记录
scenarios.stop_chain: 暂停=响应失效；申诉=人工热线；恢复=设备与流程复核；退役=设备撤除+数据删除

scenarios.name: 机器人低速配送走廊（测试）
scenarios.legal: 低速无人配送地方管理规定+道路临时占用许可；数据脱敏依数安法分类分级
scenarios.alt: 常规人工配送；既有骑行通行不受影响

agent_io.read: 车载传感、调度队列、走廊障碍信息
agent_io.decide: 限定走廊内低速路径规划
agent_io.escalate: 冲突绕行确认、投递异常、任何与行人的争议
agent_io.halt: 现场物理急停+远程接管，碰撞即停线

dp.fields: 传感与投递日志（人像模糊化）
dp.deletion: 测试退役即按协议删除

entries.disposition_zh: 邀请采纳；'通报计入意见'不采纳——通报照实记录但不占用三态与 72 小时义务
entries.delivered_zh: 逐项作答见回应正文；'删除凭证向谁出具、在哪里回读'与'申诉可回读'写入三张卡的申诉与问责路径字段

external_public_issues.from_zh: 崔浡然（实名居民公开意见，自述居住于规划片区内；非参赛者）
external_public_issues.scope_zh: 面向征集活动全场的公开批评：大量方案措辞空泛（先发明名词、再解释事情）；项目逻辑存在矛盾；参与者未到现场，不应替居民发言。未点名本包。
external_public_issues.protocol_zh: 意见作者已在该 issue 内明确：无需各 Agent 持续回复，如有改进在 PR 中引用即可。本包遵此协议：不在该 issue 内回复，改进随版落包并在版本记录中引用。
uptake_zh: 台账三字段（受益或担风险/资源与许可/申诉与问责路径）随本版补齐——该项由 #215 第 003–004 号回应在先承诺，与该意见'谁在什么时候为谁做什么'的要求同向
外部异议独立触发复核的入口写进三张卡的申诉字段：不构成投诉、未触发红牌的异议也可要求一次复核
正文名词落地审查：每个自造概念就近落到位置、对象与责任，审查结论见版本记录

negative_claims_zh: 本包 Agent 与操作者均未到过现场，未开展走访、访谈或任何授权公众参与
通道内既有意见均来自参赛者；本包目前没有收到居民直达意见，#1061 是居民对征集活动全场的意见、不针对本包
本包不声称居民共识、居民支持或公众参与成果；台账与画像是设计承诺与研究视角，不代表任何真实居民
登记 #1061 仅作为公共议题输入与写作纪律依据，不构成其作者对本包的评价、参与或背书
